overview.description: The First Trust International Developed Capital Strength ETF (FICS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of companies in developed markets outside of the US, screened for favorable factors regarding size, liquidity and volatility. FICS was launched on Dec 15, 2020 and is issued by First Trust.
